fb_text:
Every gate code. Every client quirk. Every "the real key is under the fake rock." It's all in your head.

That works fine when it's just you in the truck. Then you make your first hire, and your phone starts ringing at dinner.

"What's the code at the Henderson place?"
"Where do I park at the office complex?"
"Which gate actually opens?"

So you dump it into FieldNotes once. Text it like you're texting a buddy — gate code, access notes, the client's quirks, all of it.

Now your new guy asks the bot instead of calling you. The answer comes back in seconds. Your phone stays face-down at dinner.

No apps to install. No training. He texts like he already does.

Try the 60-second demo — ask it the gate code yourself:
fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
